details: This publish of @shadowmd/libsignal-node (version 0.0.0-stage) contains no executable code: the tarball is ~350 bytes with only package.json and README.md, no scripts, no bin entries, no dependencies and no install hooks. The package.json sets "stub": true and describes itself as a "Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing", and the README states that an "operational version... is awaiting a staged release". The package re-uses the unscoped name libsignal-node — the canonical package name of the Signal messaging protocol JavaScript binding — under an unrelated @shadowmd scope. Analysis of this version is metadata-only: there is no code to inspect, no network destination, and no credential access in these bytes. Prior versions published under this package name have been identified as malicious; this release is a name-holding placeholder and should be treated as staging for a follow-up version that would carry the actual payload.
